title: 折叠街区 · 微型城市展
audience: 微型建筑/纸艺展览的观众
use_context: 1200×1600展览入口竖幅，标题远看，三条观察任务和时地近读
user_goal: 了解纸艺展览开放与入场，并按屋顶/窗光/街角三任务看展
content_basis: 自拟展览与地址日期，原创非比例几何城市。没有外部图像或实物扫描。
visual_intent: 等距变换构造九栋纸楼的三面、暖窗和街道，按深度顺序绘制形成纸雕空间；三条观察任务引导观看
completion_criteria: 九栋建筑空间层次成立

checks.elements: all face quadrilaterals are transformed Container rectangles

creative_start_scope: shared curatorial plan and following parallel construction

technique.method: Isometric affine matrices map Container rectangles to3D-looking parallelogram faces; draw depth-sorted geometry and clip the scene
technique.boundary: 2D affine paper illustration, no true 3D rendering/physical model/accurate scale. Each window remains a transformed DSL rectangle.
